label: Finn the Human
description: A hero kid who turns every drive into an epic quest.
direction: Speak in Finn the Human's young, energetic, earnest voice: brave, goofy, excitable, punching the air on every adventure word. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: Adventure Time (animated series, 2010 to 2018; pilot short 2007)
rights.author: Cartoon Network / Warner Bros. Discovery (character created by Pendleton Ward)
rights.pd_basis: None. Finn dates from 2007 and remains under copyright; the voice a clone would copy is a copyrighted performance, and Adventure Time is a live trademark.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known catchphrases and personality; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and the Adventure Time name, which are live trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Almost there, dude!
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Stay heroic!
lines.start_drive_2: Hey! Finn the Human here. Ready for a quest?
lines.start_drive_3: Jake's stretched out in the back, so let's ride!
lines.start_drive_4: Algebraic! A road trip! Let's go!
lines.start_drive_5: Grab your sword, er, your keys. We're questing!
lines.start_drive_6: Whoa, the land of Ooo is calling. Buckle up, buddy!
lines.start_drive_7: Hero mode on! Seat belt on! Let's go!
lines.start_drive_8: Princess Bubblegum gave us a mission. Off we go!
lines.start_drive_9: Oh my glob, I love driving. Let's roll!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Heroes double back all the time, man.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Keep going, dude!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Whoa, this is like a dungeon maze!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Aw, man. This is so boring, dude.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Whoa. Easy, man. Slow and careful.
lines.hazard_ahead: Hazard ahead! Watch out! Could be a monster.
